text: ああ　わたしの　ガーディ…　どうして　しんで　しまったの…

structure.jp: ああ　わたしの　ガーディ…
どうして　しんで　しまったの…
structure.en: why did you go and die...

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. しんで　しまった = 'went and died'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a question asks for an explanation in a soft, feeling way. しまったの = 'did you (go and do it)?'
